newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Berlusconi has emergency surgery, is well.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Berlusconi has emergency surgery, is well.

text.p: Italian opposition leader and media tycoon Silvio Berlusconi has had emergency surgery to remove a kidney stone, a statement issued by his political party Forza Italia said on Monday.
The 60-year-old former prime minister was earlier rushed to Milan's San Raffaele hospital after a "sudden and painful attack of renal colic."
Berlusconi, head of the Fininvest SpA media empire, underwent an operation to remove a kidney stone, the statement said.
"The operation was completely successful and Berlusconi will be discharged within a few days," it added.
